winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

clip_research.source_claim: John Woods says the Bank of Japan's intervention in the bond market is new news and they need to look closely at whether it is a one-off or sustained.
clip_research.public_baseline: As of 2023, the Bank of Japan had a history of yield curve control and occasional interventions, but the specific intervention mentioned is not verified in public snippets.

evidence.fact: Speaker explicitly states 'this is new news' and questions if it's a one-off.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the Bank of Japan intervention is confirmed without public evidence.

clip_research.source_claim: John Woods says we could be in a higher-for-longer environment and that real rates are returning to a pre-GFC paradigm of 2-3%.
clip_research.public_baseline: In 2023, many economists debated whether rates would stay higher for longer, but no specific consensus is found in snippets.

evidence.fact: Speaker states 'higher for longer' and references real rates around 2-3% before GFC.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim this is a consensus view without public evidence.

clip_research.source_claim: John Woods says Lombard Odier does not see the Fed moving this year, and recommends short to medium duration positioning.
clip_research.public_baseline: In 2023, market expectations were for potential rate cuts, but Lombard Odier's official stance is not directly found in snippets.

evidence.fact: Speaker explicitly says 'we do not see the Fed moving this year'.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim this is Lombard Odier's official published forecast without public evidence.

clip_research.source_claim: John Woods says a gradual move in real rates is not concerning, but a pronounced dramatic move would be.

evidence.fact: Speaker states 'if we see a gradual move in real rates, I don't think it spooks the market'.

clip_research.source_claim: John Woods says Lombard Odier upgraded US equities to overweight and is upgrading Taiwan equities, citing broadening earnings and non-AI CapEx.
clip_research.public_baseline: No public snippets found confirming Lombard Odier's specific equity ratings for US and Taiwan in 2023.

evidence.fact: Speaker says 'we have changed the call on you as equities. You're no longer underweight' and mentions upgrading Taiwan.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim this is a published recommendation without public evidence.

clip_research.source_claim: Bonnie Chan says Hong Kong and mainland markets are complementary, and there is a growing trend of dual listings.
clip_research.public_baseline: HKEX has often been seen as competing with mainland exchanges, but Chan's view is a common narrative in the industry.

evidence.fact: Speaker states 'I actually see our relationship quite differently. It's complimentary.'

clip_research.public_baseline: HKEX launched the Hang Seng Tech Index, but the 'HKEX Tech 100' is not widely known; no public snippets found.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the index is well-known without public evidence.

Facebook post confirms Chan mentioned close to 10 international companies.

subtitles.zh: 约翰·伍兹来到我们节目，他是亚洲首席投资官，也是隆巴德·奥迪耶亚洲投资方案主管。
subtitles.en: John Woods is here with us on sets, Asia, CIO, and head of investment solution at Longboard, ODA.

subtitles.zh: 你们对发达市场主权债券持中性立场。这一事件是否改变了你们的看法？如果有变化，是什么？
subtitles.en: You guys are neutral DM sovereign bonds. This has changed your mind at all over that call. What does this change if at all?

subtitles.zh: 这是新消息，我们需要密切关注。
subtitles.en: Well, this is new news. This is something that we have to look at closely.

subtitles.zh: 这是否是一次性事件？还是市场干预的持续系列行动的一部分？
subtitles.en: Is it a one-off? Is it part of a sustained series of interventions in the market?

subtitles.zh: 显然，这涉及实际收益率和期限溢价。干预是否影响或改变这一点，尚不确定。
subtitles.en: Obviously, this is a real yield in term premium story. And whether intervention impacts that or changes that is less certain.

subtitles.zh: 几周前美国也进行了干预，但似乎更像是一次性行动，而非持续协调的干预计划。
subtitles.en: We, of course, had the US intervening in the end a couple of weeks ago that seemed to be more of a one-off than a sustained concerted program of intervention.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为市场和像我们这样的资产配置者将密切关注其影响。如果是一次性事件，我认为不会有重大影响。
subtitles.en: So I think the market and people like us, asset allocators, will be looking very closely at what this translate to. If it's a one-off, I don't think it has any major impact at all.

subtitles.zh: 这是基本面故事，而非干预故事。5.3%的收益率可能是30年期触及该水平时的膝跳反应，或许被视为某种必要的反应。
subtitles.en: It's a fundamental story rather than an intervention story. Possibly that 5.3 was a knee-jerk reaction when the 30-year hit that level maybe that was seen as some sort of a reaction required.

subtitles.zh: 但我的感觉是，如果是一次性事件，它不会显著改变轨迹。但我们需要更清楚地看到期限溢价将如何被解决。
subtitles.en: But my sense is that it's not going to change the meaningfully the trajectory if it's a one-off. But until we get to see more sense of how that term premium is going to be addressed.

subtitles.zh: 那么您认为最终什么能压低利率？如果不是这种干预，如果是一次性事件，
subtitles.en: So what do you think ultimately could bring rates lower? If it's not intervention like this, if it's a one-off,

subtitles.zh: 显然，有很多因素压制长端利率，比如AI投资热潮、政策不确定性、油价等。
subtitles.en: I mean, obviously there's so many things that are weighing on the long end, whether it's this AI investment boom, the effect uncertainty, oil prices, and the light.

subtitles.zh: 最终，您认为下一个推动利率下行的催化剂是什么？我不知道利率是否会下行。
subtitles.en: Ultimately, what is the next catalyst you think to bring rates down? I don't know if rates are going to head down.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们可能处于利率长期维持高位的环境。请记住，这是实际利率的故事，而非名义利率。
subtitles.en: I mean, I think that we could well be in a higher for longer environment. Bear in mind, this is a real rates story rather than a nominal rate story.

subtitles.zh: 就在2022年，我们还处于负实际利率。现在我认为价值正在回归利率市场。这类似于全球流动性变化前的情况，当时实际利率在2%到3%左右。
subtitles.en: As recently as 2022, we were having negative real rates. And now I think value is returning to the rates market. It's sort of akin to what we saw before the GFC where you saw real rates around 2 to 3 percent.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们现在正在回归这种范式。讽刺的是，我认为这可能是积极的，至少对储蓄者而言。这只是利率水平的广泛正常化，远离后危机时期的异常和紧急状态。
subtitles.en: And I think we're returning to that paradigm now. I actually think it's probably positive, ironically, but not least for savers. But for just seeing a broad normalization of rates levels, away from the abnormality and emergency post-GFC per

subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为这正是埃德·亚德尼昨晚所说的。他在与约翰·费雷尔交谈。这不是新事物，只是回归常态。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think that's what Ed Yardani said overnight as well. He was speaking with John Ferrell. I mean, this is not that this is new. This is simply a return to what was.

subtitles.zh: 那么您对关注国债收益率曲线的人有何建议？应该处于哪个位置？这对美联储有何影响？您是否担心美联储的鹰派立场？
subtitles.en: So what's your advice for people looking at a Treasury curve? Where do you want to be there? And how does this affect the Fed? Do you fear the hawkishness around the Fed?

subtitles.zh: 我们在隆巴德的观点可能逆势，我们认为美联储今年不会行动。诚然，市场正在定价加息。
subtitles.en: Well, we're at Lombard earlier, possibly contrarian, in that we do not see the Fed moving this year. Admittedly, the market is pricing in a hike.

subtitles.zh: 但我们认为，随着通胀回落，无论是整体还是核心CPI，加息预期将被重新评估。
subtitles.en: But we think that as inflation ticks lower, both headline and core as the CPI ticks lower, we think that those rate heights will be reprised.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为这不一定是一个关于短端的故事。因此，我的感觉是，为了获得最优回报，应该配置短中期久期。
subtitles.en: So I don't think this is necessarily a short-end story. Consequently, my sense is that you are in a short to medium duration positioning for the optimum return.

subtitles.zh: 我认为长端会有些波动，因为市场会对消息做出反应，就像昨晚那样。但对我们来说，这是短中期久期的故事，大约四五年，这是我们的甜点区。
subtitles.en: I think that the long end is going to be a little bit volatile because the market will be reacting to stories as we saw last night. But for us, it's a short to mid-duration story, sort of maybe four, five years, that's our sweet spot.

subtitles.zh: 从长端利率抛售中我们学到的是，它似乎再次唤醒了跨资产相关性，开始让股市有些波动。
subtitles.en: What we learn from the sell-off on long rates is that it seems like it's awoken the cross-asset correlations again, where it's starting to wobble stocks a bit.

subtitles.zh: 黄金开始出现，可能再次确认与美元的相关性。您如何看待当前市场中的相关性？
subtitles.en: You're starting to get gold, maybe reaffirmal about that correlation with the dollar. I mean, how do you look at the correlations now in this market?

- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.

- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. - words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.speaker: Bonnie Chan
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX)
briefs.current_title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：延长交易时段，提升市场可及性

subtitles.zh: 我也经常被问到这个问题，延长交易时间。
subtitles.en: So, I get asked that question a lot as well, extension of trading hours.

subtitles.zh: 首先，我想概括地说，投资者想要更好的可及性。
subtitles.en: So first of all, I would generalize it to say that investors want better access.

subtitles.zh: 可及性是投资者想要的，而且借助技术，对吧？
subtitles.en: Accessibility is what investors want, and with technology, right?

subtitles.zh: 你知道，你想拿出手机，随时都能交易。
subtitles.en: You know, you want to take your mobile phone out and be able to trade whenever you want to.

subtitles.zh: 因此，作为总体主题，我们肯定会致力于许多举措来提高可及性。
subtitles.en: So as a general theme, we certainly will be working on a lot of initiatives to improve accessibility.

subtitles.zh: 这是我们一定会做的。
subtitles.en: That is something we'll do for sure.

subtitles.zh: 关于交易时间，每个市场略有不同。
subtitles.en: Now, with trading hours, each market is slightly different.

subtitles.zh: 我们有我们的独特性。
subtitles.en: We have our uniqueness.

subtitles.zh: 我们计划做的是，先从衍生品市场开始，实际上我们现在已经交易到凌晨3点。
subtitles.en: What we think we will do, and you have shared with the market before, we will start with the derivative market, which in fact, we now trade until 3 a.m. in the morning already.

subtitles.zh: 但我们看到有很好的潜力延长交易时间，以便与美国市场开盘时间重叠。
subtitles.en: But that, we see good potential to extend it so that we can overlap with the opening of the US hour.

subtitles.zh: 因此，在第一阶段，你应该会听到我们延长衍生品交易时间的消息。
subtitles.en: And therefore, I think in the first phase, you should expect to hear from us the extension of trading hours on the derivatives side.

subtitles.zh: 就是这样。
subtitles.en: There we go.

subtitles.zh: 是的，那是港交所CEO陈翊庭，与我们的主持人Minmin Lowe。
subtitles.en: Yeah, and that was Bonnie Chan, of course, the CEO of HKX with our very own, of course, Minmin Lowe there.

briefs.speaker: Angle Jagan
briefs.speaker_context: Strategic Investment Director at Leedshine Technology
briefs.current_title: 力德科技战略总监：人形机器人核心部件订单激增10倍，量产时代来临
current_title_lines: 人形机器人核心部件订单激增10倍

subtitles.zh: 我认为无框力矩电机、集成模块化关节等核心部件，增速会远超其他部件。
subtitles.en: Oh, I think the key components like frameless torque motors or the integrated modular joints got to grow much faster than the other parts.

subtitles.zh: 以力德为例，去年我们交付了超12万台无框力矩电机，同比增长10倍。
subtitles.en: For example, as to Lee Shan, last year we shipped over 120,000 units of frameless torque which is a 10X Y-O-Y increase

subtitles.zh: 今年我们已接到的订单已超100万台，又是近10倍的增长。
subtitles.en: and this year the orders we received have already surpassed 1 million units so that's a nearly 10-fold increase.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为订单正从小批量原型或试产，转向量产订单，尤其是……
subtitles.en: So I think the orders are transitioning from like smart batch prototype or pilot works to mass production orders, especially for...

briefs.speaker: Angle Jagan
briefs.speaker_context: Strategic Investment Director at Leedshine Technology
briefs.current_title: 力德科技战略总监：已为多家海外人形机器人公司供货，样品测试进行中
current_title_lines: 已为多家海外人形机器人公司供货

subtitles.zh: 实际上，我们是多家国内头部人形机器人公司的主要供应商，包括去年全球出货量第一的智元机器人。
subtitles.en: Actually we are the major supplier of many top domestic human robot companies including Agibot which ranked the first globally in the shipments of human robot last year,

subtitles.zh: 还有睿智能、银河通用、艾克斯等公司。
subtitles.en: and also for re-intelligence, Galaxia, Axe humanoid, etc.

subtitles.zh: 正如你提到的，我们与许多海外人形机器人公司有接触，并已向他们提供样品进行测试。
subtitles.en: And as you mentioned, actually we're in touch with many overseas human robot companies and we've actually provided them with samples for testing

subtitles.zh: 其中一些公司，我们已经开始批量供货。
subtitles.en: and for some of them we have already started to supply volume.

briefs.speaker: Angle Jagan
briefs.speaker_context: Strategic Investment Director at Leedshine Technology
briefs.current_title: 力德科技战略总监：产能扩张进行时，定增计划助力人形机器人业务
current_title_lines: 定增计划助力人形机器人业务

subtitles.zh: 既然你提到需求旺盛、订单很多，那你们的产能情况如何？
subtitles.en: Now, since you mentioned you're seeing a ton of demand in a lot of orders. How are you guys doing in terms of capacity?

subtitles.zh: 产能够用吗？是否在考虑增加资本开支？我快速看了下你们的现金流，似乎正在加大运营投入。
subtitles.en: Are you okay with capacity? Are you looking to increase Capix, for example, and I just had a very quick glance at your cash flows and it does see you guys are investing in as far as operations are concerned.

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们一直在扩张产能。
subtitles.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah. We always expand our capacity.

subtitles.zh: 实际上，公司今年有定增计划，但申请还在证监会审核中。
subtitles.en: Actually, the company has a private placement plan this year, but the application is still under the review by China Stocks Regulatory Commission

subtitles.zh: 一旦获批，我们将募集大量资金，其中一部分将投入人形机器人产业，特别是扩大产能。
subtitles.en: and once it is approved, we've got to raise a large amount of money, so some of them will be invested in the human robotics industry especially to expand our production capacity.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

briefs.speaker_context: Asia CIO and head of investment solutions, Asia, at Lombard Odier
briefs.current_title: 瑞银首席：美联储今年或按兵不动，短中期债券是甜点区
current_title_lines: 瑞银首席：美联储今年或按兵不动

subtitles.zh: 那么您对关注国债收益率曲线的人有何建议？应该处于哪个位置？这对美联储有何影响？您是否担心美联储的鹰派立场？
subtitles.en: So what's your advice for people looking at a Treasury curve? Where do you want to be there? And how does this affect the Fed? Do you fear the hawkishness around the Fed?

subtitles.zh: 我们在隆巴德的观点可能逆势，我们认为美联储今年不会行动。诚然，市场正在定价加息。
subtitles.en: Well, we're at Lombard earlier, possibly contrarian, in that we do not see the Fed moving this year. Admittedly, the market is pricing in a hike.

subtitles.zh: 但我们认为，随着通胀回落，无论是整体还是核心CPI，加息预期将被重新评估。
subtitles.en: But we think that as inflation ticks lower, both headline and core as the CPI ticks lower, we think that those rate heights will be reprised.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为这不一定是一个关于短端的故事。因此，我的感觉是，为了获得最优回报，应该配置短中期久期。
subtitles.en: So I don't think this is necessarily a short-end story. Consequently, my sense is that you are in a short to medium duration positioning for the optimum return.

subtitles.zh: 我认为长端会有些波动，因为市场会对消息做出反应，就像昨晚那样。但对我们来说，这是短中期久期的故事，大约四五年，这是我们的甜点区。
subtitles.en: I think that the long end is going to be a little bit volatile because the market will be reacting to stories as we saw last night. But for us, it's a short to mid-duration story, sort of maybe four, five years, that's our sweet spot.

subtitles.zh: 从长端利率抛售中我们学到的是，它似乎再次唤醒了跨资产相关性，开始让股市有些波动。
subtitles.en: What we learn from the sell-off on long rates is that it seems like it's awoken the cross-asset correlations again, where it's starting to wobble stocks a bit.

subtitles.zh: 黄金开始出现，可能再次确认与美元的相关性。您如何看待当前市场中的相关性？
subtitles.en: You're starting to get gold, maybe reaffirmal about that correlation with the dollar. I mean, how do you look at the correlations now in this market?

briefs.speaker: Bonnie Chan
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX)
briefs.current_title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：恒生科技指数调整，更贴近市场

subtitles.zh: 你们去年推出了恒生科技指数，但不到一年，你们就在考虑调整。
subtitles.en: You launched the HKX tech 100 index last year, but less than a year on, you're looking at making some adjustments.

subtitles.zh: 是的。能告诉我们更多关于这些调整以及为什么做出这些调整吗？
subtitles.en: Correct. Could you tell us more about these adjustments and why you're making them?

subtitles.zh: 好的。首先，让我谈谈我们的指数业务以及我们为什么这样做。
subtitles.en: Right. Well, first of all, let me tell you about our index business and why we're doing it.

subtitles.zh: 我们确实认为，随着市场关注度回升，投资者对指数的需求非常强烈，以便更好地进行基准比较和参考。
subtitles.en: We certainly think that, as, you know, more focus are turning back to our market, there is a very strong demand from the investors to want to get access to these indices so that, you know, they can have better benchmarking and referencing.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们相信香港市场将受益于更多样化的指数。
subtitles.en: And therefore, first of all, we do believe that Hong Kong as a market certainly will benefit from a bigger variety of indices.

subtitles.zh: 鉴于我们与市场紧密相连，我们处于独特的位置来发展我们的指数业务。
subtitles.en: And therefore, given how close we are to the market, we do believe that we are in a very unique position to, to develop our history.

subtitles.zh: 那么你们与现有基准指数有何不同？
subtitles.en: How do you differentiate from the existing benchmarks like the Hong thing, though?

subtitles.zh: 哦，我会说非常不同。
subtitles.en: Oh, well, it's quite different, I would say.

subtitles.zh: 正如名称所示，恒生科技指数，对吧？
subtitles.en: So the name suggests, the HKX tech 100 index, right?

subtitles.zh: 其成分股是100只股票。
subtitles.en: So the underlying is 100 stocks.

subtitles.zh: 我们特意使其更加多元化，我们认为这更能代表当前市场的构成。
subtitles.en: And we deliberately make it in a way so that it's more diverse, which we believe is more representative of the makeup of our market now.

subtitles.zh: 我知道你反驳了关于中国公司上市过度集中的批评。
subtitles.en: I know you've hit back against this criticism of over-concentration of Chinese companies listing here.

briefs.speaker: Bonnie Chan
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX)
briefs.current_title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：吸引国际企业，拓展全球市场

subtitles.zh: 当然。
subtitles.en: Absolutely.

subtitles.zh: 许多公司，尤其是亚洲地区的公司，由于持续需要进入资本市场来支持增长，他们非常喜欢香港，因为香港拥有更深的流动性池。
subtitles.en: A lot of the companies, especially in the Asian region, they, because of, you know, the constant need for accessing the capital markets to support their growth, they quite like the fact that they can access Hong Kong, which has obviously a

subtitles.zh: 因此，对于那些已经超越本土市场的公司来说，在香港上市非常有吸引力。
subtitles.en: And so, you know, for companies which might have outgrown their domestic market, having another listing in Hong Kong is very, very attractive.

subtitles.zh: 目前，我们的上市管道中大约有10家国际公司。
subtitles.en: Now, in our pipeline, we actually have close to 10 companies, which are what we call international companies.

subtitles.zh: 他们来自不同地区，不仅限于亚洲和中亚。
subtitles.en: And they are applying for a listing in Hong Kong from various regions, not only Asia and Central Asia.

subtitles.zh: 我还想强调，我们正在与区域交易所建立大量合作。
subtitles.en: I also want to emphasize the fact that we are forging a lot of collaboration with regional exchanges.

subtitles.zh: 如你所知，我最近去了马来西亚。
subtitles.en: As you know, I have recently been to Malaysia.

subtitles.zh: 我们与马来西亚交易所今年三月签署了合作备忘录。
subtitles.en: With personal Malaysia, we signed an MOU with them in March this year.

subtitles.zh: 我们最近认可他们为认可交易所，这使得在马来西亚上市的公司更容易来香港进行二次上市。
subtitles.en: And we recently recognized them as a recognized stock exchange, therefore making companies listed on personal Malaysia easier to come to Hong Kong for a secondary listing.

subtitles.zh: 这延续了我们一直在进行的其他一系列活动。
subtitles.en: And this follows a very long string of other activities that have been pursuing.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为你会听到更多关于我们吸引非中国公司上市进展的消息。
subtitles.en: But I do think that you should expect to hear more about our progress, you know, in terms of attracting non-Chinese companies to list on other things.

subtitles.zh: 听起来很多焦点都在亚洲。
subtitles.en: It sounds like a lot of focus is on Asia.

subtitles.zh: 你们是否也瞄准其他地区，比如中东或世界其他地区？
subtitles.en: Are you also targeting other regions, like the Middle East or other parts of the world?

subtitles.zh: 是的，当然。
subtitles.en: Yeah. Absolutely, absolutely.

subtitles.zh: 但你听到我更多谈论亚洲的原因，坦白说是因为我之前提到的观点，即国际投资者整体上更加关注亚洲。
subtitles.en: But, you know, the reason that you hear me talk more about Asia is frankly because of the point I refer to earlier, which is the fact that it seems to make me that international investors on the whole are getting more focused on Asia.

briefs.speaker: Bonnie Chan
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX)
briefs.current_title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：延长交易时段，提升市场可及性

subtitles.zh: 我也经常被问到这个问题，延长交易时间。
subtitles.en: So, I get asked that question a lot as well, extension of trading hours.

subtitles.zh: 首先，我想概括地说，投资者想要更好的可及性。
subtitles.en: So first of all, I would generalize it to say that investors want better access.

subtitles.zh: 可及性是投资者想要的，而且借助技术，对吧？
subtitles.en: Accessibility is what investors want, and with technology, right?

subtitles.zh: 你知道，你想拿出手机，随时都能交易。
subtitles.en: You know, you want to take your mobile phone out and be able to trade whenever you want to.

subtitles.zh: 因此，作为总体主题，我们肯定会致力于许多举措来提高可及性。
subtitles.en: So as a general theme, we certainly will be working on a lot of initiatives to improve accessibility.

subtitles.zh: 这是我们一定会做的。
subtitles.en: That is something we'll do for sure.

subtitles.zh: 关于交易时间，每个市场略有不同。
subtitles.en: Now, with trading hours, each market is slightly different.

subtitles.zh: 我们有我们的独特性。
subtitles.en: We have our uniqueness.

subtitles.zh: 我们计划做的是，先从衍生品市场开始，实际上我们现在已经交易到凌晨3点。
subtitles.en: What we think we will do, and you have shared with the market before, we will start with the derivative market, which in fact, we now trade until 3 a.m. in the morning already.

subtitles.zh: 但我们看到有很好的潜力延长交易时间，以便与美国市场开盘时间重叠。
subtitles.en: But that, we see good potential to extend it so that we can overlap with the opening of the US hour.

subtitles.zh: 因此，在第一阶段，你应该会听到我们延长衍生品交易时间的消息。
subtitles.en: And therefore, I think in the first phase, you should expect to hear from us the extension of trading hours on the derivatives side.

subtitles.zh: 就是这样。
subtitles.en: There we go.

subtitles.zh: 是的，那是港交所CEO陈翊庭，与我们的主持人Minmin Lowe。
subtitles.en: Yeah, and that was Bonnie Chan, of course, the CEO of HKX with our very own, of course, Minmin Lowe there.

subtitles.zh: 既然你提到需求旺盛、订单很多，那你们的产能情况如何？
